name: Gilboa
overview: Gilboa is a significant location in Scripture as the site of a devastating defeat for Israel, where King Saul and his sons were slain by the Philistines. The battle described in 1 Samuel 31 reveals the tragic end of Saul's reign, marked by his severe wounding and subsequent suicide to avoid capture and abuse by the enemy. This event underscores the consequences of Saul's disobedience to God and sets the stage for the rise of David, God's chosen king. The account at Gilboa thus serves as a sober reminder of the cost of turning away from God's commands.
